cells.gaps: No source found reports Tunisian payments running on PAPSS: the BCT has belonged since February 2024 and sets how banks join, with no live participation reported.
cells.note: The BCT manages the SGMT RTGS and oversees SIBTEL, the interbank clearing system, read as an interoperability arrangement in service. Its PAPSS membership since February 2024 reports no live participation, which the study does not count.
